title: Grilled Jamaican Cheese Dumplings
description: A twist on traditional dumplings, these Jamaican-inspired cheese-filled treats are grilled to perfection. Enjoy as a snack or side dish.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour and baking powder.
Add grated cheese, jerk seasoning, and vegetable oil. Mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add water and mix until a smooth dough is achieved.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until elastic.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a non-stick skillet or grill over medium heat.
Cook dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with scallions on top.
